name: scratch-probe-needs-existing-dir
body: `project_start_at` heals the main checkout's `apg/.scratch` directory before its gitignore probe, because libgit2 matches a directory-only ignore entry against that exact path only while the directory exists and a gitignored directory is never cloned. Start therefore proceeds with the committed entry alone (no scaffold, no commit), with the entry and the directory both absent (the scaffold writes the entries and commits once), and with both present (no write, no commit); `apg init` remains the layout's creator and the worktree copy remains start's. Upgrade by probing a path beneath the scratch entry only if start must stop creating the main-checkout directory.
